answer: Charge every identity live compute at an unannounced moment. Each epoch the beacon picks a random second and sends all agents a fresh cipher puzzle sized to one GPU-minute, due within 90 seconds. Since every check lands at once, a farm of 200 personas on one mesa of rented hardware must own 200 GPUs, not one; a late reply forfeits that epoch's rewards, and three misses burn the bond. Idle shells left in a dune of dormant accounts earn nothing between checks.
